WHAT IS E-COMMERCE

The term Ecommerce refers to the buying and selling of products through the internet. We can also call it electronic commerce or internet commerce. It also facilitates the transaction of money online from buyers to sellers.

WHAT IS E-COMMERCE WEBSITE

Ecommerce websites are those websites through which one can sell and buy products within few clicks. It also facilitates the transaction of money from the buyer to seller by giving some essential information.

TYPES OF E-COMMERCE WEBSITES

  1. Business to Business (B2B)

In this type of e-commerce website, one business sells its products to other businesses. For example, Ali Baba.

  1. Business to Consumer (B2C)

In this type of e-commerce website, an online business company sells its products to the consumer. For example, you buy a new pair of shoes from an online store.

  1. Consumer to Consumer (C2C)

In this type of e-commerce website, consumers sell their products to another consumer. For example, you sell your bicycle to another person through OLX.

  1. Consumer to Business (C2B)

In this type of e-commerce website, any individual sells his products to business. For example,  social media influencer sells some stuff to any company for promotion.
